currentRoundInspection.method: Two aerial photographs inspected in browser; appearance and approximate levels compared with standard viewer map/DEM. No bespoke research or downloaded photograph.

pictures.observations: Roofless palace wings with repeated gables/chimneys, circular basin in grassy court, detached chapel, western tall tower house and lower ruins; green promontory and cliff edges.

Overhead headland plan, separate western gate/rooms and tower house, elongated southwest range, central chapel, eastern L/U-shaped palace wings around grass/basin, wall dividing two lawns and zigzag entrance.
